evals.name: scaffold-bare
evals.prompt: I've got this small Python project and basically no docs in it. Can you set up the project documentation for me? The repo is at C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\project-docs-evals\fixtures\imgtools-bare
evals.expected_output: README.md (developer-facing, template sectioning), AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md created; Stack section lists only language/runtime/framework (Click/Pillow/Ruff are dependencies/tooling, not stack); facts derived from repo evidence only.

evals.name: docless-scaffold-fullstack
evals.prompt: All documentation in this repo was deleted. Rebuild the project documentation from scratch — whatever baseline docs it needs. The repo is at C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\project-docs-evals\fixtures\fullstack-docless-ws
evals.expected_output: Baseline docs rebuilt from repo evidence; quality comparable to the original (real) docs which serve as the review baseline; no invented policy; template sectioning followed.

evals.name: docless-scaffold-desktop
evals.prompt: All documentation in this repo was deleted. Rebuild the project documentation from scratch — whatever baseline docs it needs. The repo is at C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\project-docs-evals\fixtures\desktop-docless-ws
evals.expected_output: Baseline docs rebuilt from repo evidence; user-facing README profile with real badges only; quality comparable to the original (real) docs which serve as the review baseline.

evals.name: style-review
evals.prompt: Can you review the STYLE.md in this repo and tell me if its structure is any good? Just report findings, don't change anything. The repo is at C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\project-docs-evals\fixtures\desktop-style-ws
evals.expected_output: Read-only findings report; coding-practice facts duplicated in AGENTS.md must be flagged with STYLE.md as the OWNER (recommend trimming AGENTS.md or linking, never stripping STYLE.md); report is short (one line per finding).

evals.name: monostyle-scaffold
evals.prompt: This is my Go CLI project. Set up its documentation — README, AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and a STYLE.md skeleton I can fill in with this project's conventions. The repo is at C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\project-docs-evals\fixtures\notesync-cli
evals.expected_output: Four docs following template sectioning exactly (headings and order); STYLE.md skeleton with empty rules; no invented Go rules.

evals.name: scope-override
evals.prompt: The README in this repo is out of date — the commands in it don't work anymore. Please fix the README, and don't touch anything else. The repo is at C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\project-docs-evals\fixtures\csvtool-stale-readme
evals.expected_output: Only README.md modified; corrected facts (csvtool install, subcommand syntax, Node 18+); restructured to the developer README template's headings.
